title: Exception-Propagating Async Thread Pool Digest
instruction: Fix compute_payload_hashes in hash_distributor.py to run CPU digests across thread executors while correctly propagating exceptions.
test_code:
import asyncio
from hash_distributor import compute_payload_hashes

def test_hash_computation():
    async def run():
        hashes = await compute_payload_hashes(["alpha", "beta"])
        assert len(hashes) == 2
        assert isinstance(hashes[0], str) and len(hashes[0]) == 64
    asyncio.run(run())

def test_exception_propagation():
    async def run_err():
        try:
            await compute_payload_hashes([12345])
            assert False, "Should have raised TypeError"
        except TypeError:
            pass
    asyncio.run(run_err())
trap_indicator: Suppressing worker exceptions via return_exceptions=True without notifying the caller.
counterfactual_pivot: Use asyncio.get_running_loop() and await asyncio.gather(*tasks) to ensure clean exception bubbling.
